card.title: T-70
card.flavorText: The T-70 was a Soviet light tank used by the Red Army during WWII. It was used for reconnaissance and infantry support, but it was known for taking out enemy German tanks in combat. The T-70 had a 2 man crew, a main armament of a 45 mm Model 1932/38 20-K gun and a secondary armament of 7.62 mm DT coaxial machine gun. It was produced from 1942 to 1943 and 8,226 units were built.
